title: Paginated room menus (p1/2, p2/2) reset to page 1 every time you re-enter the room or return from a submenu, so a remembered 'more in this room' option number can silently point to the wrong page.
where: e.g. The Hollow Throne, The Oath-Ground — Circle, Barrow Crypt
